- Document the judgement calls behind a cleaned dataset

# 3. Practice

## Exercise {background="#43464B"}

On your own property:

1. Configure internal traffic filtering and a hostname filter
2. Write a cleaning script from raw export to clean dataset
3. Produce a cleaning log with at least four documented rules
4. Report your key metric before and after cleaning, and explain the gap

**30 minutes**

## The Rule

TODO: expand. An agent may **propose** an exclusion. Only you may **accept** one,
and acceptance means you can say why in one sentence.

## Exercise {background="#43464B"}

1. Ask an agent to propose cleaning rules for your export
2. Accept the ones you can justify, reject the rest
3. Record the rejected ones and your reason, which is also part of the trail
